title: ACS Fall is happening this week. If you work on CMC data infrastructure, let’s chat.
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
**ACS Fall is happening this week. If you work on CMC data infrastructure, let’s chat.**


The main thing I want to get a better insight on while I'm here is what actually stops pharma and chemical companies from turning their archive of chemical data into their most valuable asset.


We've heard it numerous times: historical campaigns sit somewhere nobody can easily reach, often with missing metadata. Data discipline is the game changer here.


Nothing glamorous. But it's the prerequisite for every data-driven workflow downstream.


The reason I keep coming back to this is that it’s one of the five gaps I’ll be talking about on Monday. The memory gap: most campaigns start from zero because historic data is rarely reused effectively.


Never heard of these gaps? Come along and I’ll walk you through all five or find me at the @ReactWise booth #224.


Robust Bayesian Optimization for Accelerating Process Development Monday August 24, 5:00 - 5:20 PM Room W184bc, McCormick Place


See you around the conference.
